description: One heads-up PLO4 hand, as played, against the flop blueprint in one call: every flop decision mapped onto the blueprint tree (sizes to the nearest blueprint size), and for each of the hero's decisions the best action, every action's EV for the exact hand, the loss of the action played (bb and % of pot), whether it counts as a mistake, the hand's percentile in its range and the opponent's response to each action. `hand` is a parsed hand history: big blind, the two players with starting stacks and hole cards, every action with street, type and chip amount, and the board. `hero` is the hero's player name. The stack is matched to the nearest blueprint depth. When this exact turn spot has already been solved, `turnDecisions` gives the same answers for every turn decision, and when that turn solve covers the river the hand reached, `riverDecisions` does the same for the river. Turn and river spots that are not solved yet are reported as unsolved.

hand.description: One parsed heads-up PLO4 hand history. Amounts are chips, in the same unit as bigBlind. Uploaded-hand summary rows are not this shape: they carry no stacks or per-action amounts.

actions.description: Every action in order, blinds included. Bets and raises are the street total the player raised to; calls are the chips added.

actionType.description: What the player did. UNCALLED_BET is chips returned.

amount.description: Chips for this action (0 for check and fold).

amountIsDelta.description: True if a bet or raise amount is the chips added rather than the street total.

isAllIn.description: True if the action put the player all in.

handId.description: Optional id of the hand, echoed back.

players.description: Players dealt in. Exactly two may be seated (not sitting out).

cards.description: Hole cards, e.g. "AsKsQhJh". Required for the hero.

isSittingOut.description: True if the player was not dealt in.

playerName.description: Name as it appears in the actions.

startingStack.description: Stack at the start of the hand, in chips.

hero.description: Hero's player name in the hand.

mistake_bb.description: Loss in bb above which a decision counts as a mistake (default 0.1).

name: analyze_hu_plo_hand

outputSchema.description: One heads-up PLO4 hand against the flop blueprint: every flop decision, and for the hero's the best action, EVs, loss and mistake flag.

items.description: One flop decision: line, actor, played, mappedTo, potBb, rangeStrategy; for the hero also handStrategy, handEvBb, best, evLossBb, evLossPctPot, mistake, rangePercentile, opponentResponses (or reaches: false).

effectiveStackBb.description: Effective stack in the hand, in big blinds.

error.description: Present instead of a payload when the request named something that does not exist. No figure is estimated in its place.

handId.description: Hand id when the input had one.

items.description: A note on how the hand was mapped.

preflop.description: Preflop line in blueprint names, e.g. "SB_Open_BB_Call".

river.description: When the turn is solved and the hand saw a river: the river spot (turnSpot, turnLine, card, potBb, behindBb, riverBets), spotId, whether it is solved, and `solve`, the status of a solve of this spot when one is under way.

riverDecisions.description: River decisions in order, when the river spot is solved.

items.description: One river decision from the exact river solve, in the same shape as a flop decision.

stack.description: Blueprint depth used (nearest to the effective stack).

turn.description: When the hand saw a turn: the spot (stack, preflop, flopLine, board, potBb, behindBb, turn sizes), spotId, whether it is solved, and `solve`, the status of a solve of this spot when one is under way.

turnDecisions.description: Turn decisions in order, when the spot is solved.

items.description: One turn decision from the solve of this spot, in the same shape as a flop decision.

title: Analyze a heads-up PLO4 hand
